## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or enhancement.

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or community use case? 
*Example: As a Samity Admin, I want to export monthly financial records to PDF/CSV so that I can print physical records for offline audits.*

## 🚀 Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision the feature working, including user workflow and UI touchpoints.

## 🔄 Alternative Considerations
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🎨 Mockups or Design Concepts
If applicable, include sketches, wireframes, or screenshots of similar workflows.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context or references about the feature request here.
